claims.statement: The external-server namespace is Flux Kustomization `external-server` targeting namespace `external-server`, applying components/common plus a single app Kustomization at kubernetes/apps/external-server/external-server/app, with prune, SOPS decryption, cluster-secrets substitution, 1h interval, and wait: true; it deploys no pods, HelmReleases, or SOPS secrets.

Each proxied backend in external-server is a selectorless Service paired with a same-named manual Endpoints object pointing at a fixed LAN IP and port (e.g. adguard 192.168.50.1:3000; iyuu, moviepilot, ugreen, cold-minio-api/console, hot-minio-api/console at 192.168.50.220), giving cluster-native identity to out-of-cluster services.

All eight external-server HTTPRoutes attach to the internal Gateway (kube-system, https section) providing HTTPS hostnames on ${SECRET_DOMAIN}; only the four MinIO routes (cold-minio-api, cold-minio, hot-minio-api, hot-minio) additionally attach to the external Gateway, making MinIO the only publicly reachable proxied services, and no auth middleware is applied in this namespace.
external-server is included in the Flux GitHub notification alert's watched namespaces alongside the other app namespaces.
